integrity: The symbolic infinite proof and the exact finite multiplication certificate are distinguishable and provided. Independent verification and peer review have not been performed; priority remains subject to unindexed earlier equivalent formulations and the unavailable full text of one related recent preprint.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the symmetric congruence generated by length-two palindromic duplication, not forward descendant-cone intersections or optimal codes; it does not cover alphabets larger than three. The finite 14-letter graph only certifies the finite right-multiplication table and does not decide arbitrary-long rewrites without the proof by induction.
title: The 118-class ternary quotient of length-two palindromic duplication
